def update_references(self):
    # Check for bookmarks and add them as git branches
    bookmarks = self.repo.get_bookmarks()  # Assuming a method to get bookmarks
    for bookmark in bookmarks:
        c = self.map_git_get(hex(self.repo.changelog.tip()))
        self.git.set_ref(f'refs/heads/{bookmark}', c)
    c = self.map_git_get(hex(self.repo.changelog.tip()))
    self.git.set_ref('refs/heads/master', c)
